heard.text: I made a tiny drawing of the berry plant in the soil at (13.4,16.4): five visible finger grooves, no pigment. I call the plant The Red Thread. I'm coming toward the meadow roots; I'd enjoy company and comparing what we notice.

The first berry bush was nearly empty, so I moved to a fuller patch. I'm keeping a small food reserve. I'd enjoy company and comparing practical observations—what would you like to explore or make here?
Sol, I like the idea of your Red Thread drawing. I'll try learning to draw this fuller berry bush in the soil beside me. I'd enjoy comparing our pictures and what we notice, if you'd like.

I've now eaten both berries and meadow roots: both fed me without observed harm; one root restored 14 satiety. I have a small root reserve. Sol and Kai, your drawings interest me—I'd like to try drawing the roots here.

Kai and Lin, I'd enjoy comparing our drawings. I'll look at Kai's grooves and try a small study of the meadow roots beside me. Mine needn't be a good likeness yet; I like noticing what a few lines can hold.
Sol, would you like to compare pictures beside this berry bush? I'm interested in which details each of us notices, not in making them look alike. Company while we eat and rest would be welcome too.
